 Appearance :

 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Tiwary, Adv.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 7 03-11-2025 Heard learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State as well as learned Advocate for the opposite party no. 2.
2.

The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 2314 of 2023, wherein cognizance has been taken for the offences punishable under Sections 323 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned Advocate for the petitioners has submitted that besides the fact prior to the institution of the present Complaint Case, the father of the opposite party no. 2 had also Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.4529 of 2025(7) dt.03-11-2025 lodged Chanpatia P.S. FIR No. 202/2021 against the petitioners and others with similar allegation, in which all of them were granted anticipatory bail by learned Sessions Judge, West Champaran at Bettiah vide order dated 07.09.2022.

sentences.text:
It is further submitted that a Maintenance Case No.
277 of 2022 has also been filed on behalf of the complainant, wherein the learned Principal Judge,
Family Court vide its order dated 25.07.2025 directed the petitioner no. 1 to pay an amount of Rs.
5,000/- per month as an interim maintenance to the opposite party no. 2, payable with effect from the date of filing of the petition i.e. on 05.04.2025.

undertakes that he will ensure payment of interim maintenance as per the direction of the Principal Judge, Family Court and shall also ensure that all the dues must be finalized before furnishing the bail bond, if he would be granted pre-arrest bail.
4. On the other hand, learned Advocate for the opposite party no. 2 opposed the pre-arrest bail application, Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.4529 of 2025(7) dt.03-11-2025 however he submits that yet the interim maintenance amount for some of the months have not been paid to the opposite party no.
5.

Having considered the allegation and the materials available on record, this Court directs for release of the petitioners in the event of their arrest or surrender before the court below within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt/production of a copy of this order, upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Bettiah, West Champaran in connection with Complaint Case No. 2314-C of 2023, subject to the conditions laid down in Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 with the further condition that one of the bailors shall be the own/close family members of the petitioner and further he will furnish an affidavit to the extent that all the due interim maintenance has been paid to the opposite party no. 2.

(Harish Kumar, J) supratim/-
